NY Tech Week 2026

NY Tech Week moves fast.
This is your home base.

Events get crowded, schedules shift, and the best conversations often happen between official programming. Yorkseed House gives founders, investors, operators, and organizers one intentional place to flow through during the day.

Register Now
218 Lafayette St, Floor 2 · SoHo
The Space

BelongNYC becomes
the week's working lounge

BELONG NYC is a hospitality-driven amenity space in the heart of SoHo — designed for people who don't stop. Coworking, private meeting rooms, showers, lockers, dressing rooms, nap pods, and phone booths.

During NY Tech Week, it becomes a discovery layer. Register for drop-in access, then browse individual events hosted onsite and RSVP directly with each organizer.

Work & CallsDesks, phone booths, WiFi
NetworkVetted founders & investors
RechargeShowers, nap pods, lockers
Live EventsCurated programming all week

How It Works

Four steps to get in

01
Apply for Access
Register via Luma. All guests apply in advance — approved attendees get on the list.
Luma Registration
02
Pay $10 on Arrival
Scan the QR code at the door and pay $10 via Venmo or Stripe. One payment covers you for the full week.
QR Code at Door
03
Drop In & Out Freely
Come and go all day. Work, meet people, grab coffee, take meetings between sessions.
Full Week Access
04
Catch the Events
RSVP separately to any of the curated sessions happening at BelongNYC all week.
